name: chainlab
description: ChainLab — 一个看得见的 Web3 入门实验室（Solidity + Hardhat + ethers.js + React + Express + SQLite）

scripts.dev:deploy: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm --workspace contracts run deploy
scripts.dev:server: wait-on server/data/deployment.json && npm --workspace server run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace contracts run compile && npm --workspace web run build
